# Third-party components

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.32
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.32
- Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
- License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
- Packaged files: vision_bundle.mjs and wasm/*, unmodified.

- https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
- https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/image_segmenter/hair_segmenter/float32/1/hair_segmenter.tflite
